title: Blackstone Hellish Expansion
body:
**Why did I do this?** Because I'm building a Blackstone castle and only three versions aren't enough to make something decent...
And because I hate basalt.

![New Blackstone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f2700ba1240923cca0d91618623f21cd4cfd393.png)

### **Name changed - English (US)**
Basalt -> Blackstone Pillar

Polished Basalt -> Polished Blackstone Pillar

Gilded Blackstone -> Gilded Chiseled Polished Blackstone

Smooth Basalt -> Terrestrial Blackstone

### **Nombres cambiados - Español (MX)**

Basalto -> Pilar de Piedra Negra

Basalto Pulido -> Pilar de Piedra Negra Pulida

Piedra Negra Aurea -> Piedra Negra Grabada bañada en Oro

Basalto Liso -> Piedra Negra Terrestre.


### **_NO mods required_**
